shortDescription: GRAND RAPIDS, Mich., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Meritage Hospitality Group Inc. children: today announced that Michael Ruggeri, a member of the Company’s Board of Directors, resigned effective August 31, 2026.

“On behalf of the Board and the Company, I want to thank Michael for his contributions since joining the Board in 2025. We wish him well in his future endeavors,” said Robert E. Schermer, Jr., CEO of Meritage Hospitality Group Inc.

Meritage Hospitality Group currently operates 314 restaurants located in Arkansas, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Mississippi, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas and Virginia. Meritage is headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, operating with a workforce of approximately 10,000 employees. As of June 28, 2026, the Company had fully diluted weighted average common shares outstanding of 6,720,000.
